svg.title: Empty-nest downsizing: stay, buy a condo, or rent after sale
svg.desc: Labelled suburban GTA or Metro Vancouver empty-nest sketch. Staying in a $1.2 million house costs about $2,150 a month all-in. A $650,000 condo lands near $1,820. Renting a two-bedroom at Toronto Q2 2026 asking $2,650 plus utilities is about $2,780. Sale costs and land transfer tax sit outside the monthly bars.
svg.text: Downsizing saves only if the all-in stack falls
Labelled GTA / Metro Vancouver empty-nest sketch, 20 Sep 2026. StatCan QRS Q2 2026 asking 2-bed Toronto $2,650. Not a listing or appraisal.
Stay bar: tax + 1%/yr maintenance + insurance + utilities on a labelled $1.2M paid-off house. Condo bar adds a $650 fee.
Sale commission, legal, and land transfer tax on the next purchase are cash, not a monthly bar. Rent uses Toronto asking 2-bed.
Principal-residence exemption is high-level CRA context, not a clearance certificate. Not tax, legal, or brokerage advice.
